tools.heroTitle: The utilities we use every day,
tools.heroText: A collection of fast tools for developers, designers and product teams. Everything runs in your browser: your files never leave your computer.

pdfToWord.name: PDF to Word
pdfToWord.desc: Turn the content of a PDF into an editable .docx document.
pdfToWord.intro: Extract the text from your PDF and download it as a ready-to-edit Word document (.docx). The conversion happens entirely in your browser.

pdfSummary.name: PDF summary
pdfSummary.desc: Get the key ideas of a PDF or a long text in seconds.
pdfSummary.intro: Upload a PDF (or paste text) and get a summary with the most relevant sentences, keywords and reading stats.

pdfToText.name: PDF to text
pdfToText.desc: Turn any PDF into plain text ready to copy.
pdfToText.intro: Get all the text from a PDF, page by page, ready to copy or download as .txt.

imageToWebp.name: Images to WebP
imageToWebp.desc: Convert PNG, JPG, GIF or AVIF to WebP and make your site lighter.
imageToWebp.intro: Convert images from any format to WebP (also PNG or JPG), tune quality and resize in batch without leaving your browser.

audioToText.name: Audio to text
audioToText.desc: Transcribe speech to text in real time, in several languages.
audioToText.intro: Dictate or play audio and get a real-time transcription powered by your browser's speech recognition engine.

qrGenerator.name: QR code generator
qrGenerator.desc: Create QR codes for links, WiFi, contacts and more.
qrGenerator.intro: Generate custom QR codes for URLs, WiFi networks, emails, phones or contact cards and download them as PNG or SVG.

jsonFormatter.name: JSON formatter
jsonFormatter.desc: Format, minify and validate JSON instantly.
jsonFormatter.intro: Sort, indent, minify and validate your JSON structures with clear error messages.

base64.name: Base64
base64.desc: Encode and decode text or files in Base64.
base64.intro: Convert text to Base64 and back, with UTF-8 support, URL-safe variant and file to Data URL conversion.

hashGenerator.name: Hash generator
hashGenerator.desc: Compute SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384 and SHA-512 of text or files.
hashGenerator.intro: Generate cryptographic hashes from text or a file to verify integrity, using the browser's Web Crypto API.

passwordGenerator.name: Password generator
passwordGenerator.desc: Create secure random passwords with real entropy.
passwordGenerator.intro: Generate strong passwords with cryptographic randomness, control length and symbols, and check entropy in bits.

uuidGenerator.name: UUID generator
uuidGenerator.desc: Generate unique IDs: UUID v4, ULID or Nano ID.
uuidGenerator.intro: Create unique identifiers in bulk for databases, APIs or tests, in UUID v4, ULID or Nano ID format.

jwtDecoder.name: JWT decoder
jwtDecoder.desc: Inspect the header, payload and expiration of a token.
jwtDecoder.intro: Paste a JSON Web Token and review its content, claims and expiration date without sending it to any server.

colorConverter.name: Color converter
colorConverter.desc: Convert between HEX, RGB, HSL and CMYK and check contrast.
colorConverter.intro: Convert colors between formats, generate a shade scale and verify contrast against WCAG criteria.
